# ADR index (cross-namespace)

Generated from each ADR's front-matter; the per-namespace README indexes ([ADR-PC](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/README.md) · [ADR-IC](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/README.md)) carry the full decision summaries.
